title: Joint tails and drift
series: Adapt-1 Research Series — Part 2: Forecasting Through Drift

empirical_telemetry: Exp 98A: Bundesnetzagentur SMARD German DE-LU day-ahead power prices & physical grid forecasts + Open-Meteo weather (n=450 sealed OOS days, 2025-08-27..2026-11-19)

Exp 98B: Daily multi-asset ETF returns (SPY/TLT/HYG/GLD), CBOE implied volatility indices (VIX/VIX3M/VVIX/OVX/GVZ), and official scheduled Federal Reserve FOMC / BLS CPI calendars (n=726 OOS days, 2024-01-02..2026-11-20)
Exp 79B / Exp 90C: Binance public 1h spot & perpetual futures OHLCV and basis across 4 digital assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP; n=1,149 event-clock cascade steps, 2025-09-01..2026-11-23)

Exp 89B: SMARD / Bundesnetzagentur 4-TSO German wind & load (50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT, TransnetBW; cross-referenced with Fraunhofer ISE Energy-Charts definitions), Open-Meteo barometric tendency, CBOE OVX, ECB EUR FX, and daily GPRD (n=323 sealed OOS days, 2026-01-01..2026-11-19)
Exp 90A: EIA-930 US 4-ISO wind generation capacity factors (ERCO, CISO, PJM, MISO; n=318 sealed OOS days, 2026-01-01..2026-11-22)
stylized_causal_overlays: Exp 98A: Deterministic 1%-fee (0%/1%/2% swept) 1 MWh BESS arbitrage + 1 MWh peak-scarcity forward-vs-spot hedge overlay applied identically to every model's causal joint cloud

Exp 79B / Exp 90C: Deterministic 3x dynamic-leverage forced-liquidation survival overlay (5% maintenance-margin ruin floor, 0/5/15 bps one-way fees, parameters locked strictly on pre-OOS calibration data)

Exp 89B: Parameterized German evening-peak balancing-reserve dispatch overlay (4h evening peak, EUR 50/MWh standby fee, 20x VoLL = EUR 1,000/MWh headline, swept 10x/20x/50x + OVX*FX geo-stress; severe outage threshold >= 2.5 GW unserved)

regime_and_evaluation_notes: Without linear_residual transport, plain empirical weighting (Live_Adapt1_W128_Kernel, ES 65.26) trails all 12 GJR-GARCH variants because bounded convex combinations cannot extrapolate upward price drift.

Offline Local Linear Regression (ES 57.80, Desk 1% EUR 71.98) edges Adapt-1 on ES (daily p_H=0.0448, weekly p_H=0.1314) using the identical pre-auction covariates, but enters Basel RED on upward peak VaR99 (15/450 vs Adapt-1 YELLOW 11/450).
Offline Tier2_HeteroRidge (ES 59.26, Desk 1% EUR 73.47, YELLOW 9/450) ties Adapt-1 on ES (p_H=0.6544) and posts the highest 1%-fee desk PnL.
Exporting at most 128 scenarios truncates outer tail mass if max_support > 128 (Live_Adapt1_W512_Kernel degrades to ES 72.22, RED 23/450), so lossless joint clouds require W <= 128.

exp98b_catalyst_implied_vol_regime.description: Operating boundary: daily multi-asset returns (SPY/TLT/HYG/GLD) with forward options implied vol (VIX, VIX/VIX3M, VVIX, OVX, GVZ, VIX/RV5) and scheduled Federal Reserve FOMC / BLS CPI release dates.
exp98b_catalyst_implied_vol_regime.regime_takeaway: Asset-specific MLE GJR-DCC-GARCH-FHS leads full-period daily multi-asset financial ES (1.139 vs 1.145) and calm-before-storm days where the equity variance risk premium over-scales fixed-income/gold legs; pure Adapt-1 conditioning improves significantly over raw unconditional priors (p_H=0.0086) and beats GJR on VIX-inversion FRTB capital cost (p_H=0.0110) but does not beat MLE GJR on full-OOS daily return ES.

exp79b_90c_crypto_cascade.universe_note: Raw Binance 1h spot & perpetual futures panel covers BTC, ETH, SOL, and XRP (5D target vector: log inter-event duration + 4 coin Garman-Klass log-magnitudes).
leverage_and_fee_sensitivity_notes: Unlevered 1x spot lost -56.5% over the 15-month bear cascade, so surviving 3x dynamic books still suffered -92.7% to -95.3% full-period drawdowns at 5 bps.

At severe 15 bps one-way fees, turnover drag pushes Adapt-1 (step 1117), Online Ridge, and DCC-GARCH-FHS past the 5% liquidation floor, whereas lower-turnover EWMA_EmpResid (-94.21%) stays above 5% in Exp 79B.

Adapt-1 ranked #1/12 on ES_5D in Exp 79B yet failed VaR99_GK conditional coverage (p_cc=0.0007); in Exp 90C, Adapt-1 wrapping rescued Chronos-2 ctx=2048 to survival (0.0766x) while wrapped TimesFM-3.0 ctx=1024 still hit liquidation at step 1138.

exp90a_us_wind_regime.description: Operating boundary: smooth 4-ISO US wind capacity factors (EIA-930: ERCO, CISO, PJM, MISO; n=318 sealed OOS days, 2026-01-01..2026-11-22) where uncapped ctx=1,536 TSFMs are already well-calibrated and outperform both standalone W=128 Adapt-1 and residual wrapping.
exp90a_us_wind_regime.reconciliation_note: Across the two locked ctx=1,536 base TSFMs, raw VaR99 breaches are 3 (TimesFM-3.0) and 2 (Chronos-2) [mean 2.5]; Adapt-1 residual wrapping increases breaches to 4 (TimesFM-3.0) and 6 (Chronos-2) [mean 5.0], while degrading ES by -1.79% and -1.04%. The essay's '3 -> 5' shorthand summarizes this rounded mean shift from well-calibrated base breaches (~3) to wrapped breaches (5). Do not wrap already well-calibrated smooth long-context TSFMs.
